selection_scope: one incident's observed metric view after the shared modality mask; no labels
column_order: round-robin over metadata service order, preserving each service's source metric order
drop_invalid_constant: same complete/nonconstant filter as the existing official worker
maximum_columns: min(number of varying metrics, number of observed time rows minus 2)
sample_cap_reason: positive n-|conditioning set|-3 for every possible Fisher-Z test among retained variables
selection: greedily retain a candidate only if the centered unit-norm columns' Gram matrix has min_eigenvalue > 1e-8 * max_eigenvalue
metric_values_to_algorithm: original retained values, times and onset; no jitter, interpolation or value transformation
ranking: original metric-to-service adapter; removed/unranked services retained at ranking tail
